import_files_invalid.why: A model import's upload is refused before it is read: no file, more than the file cap, a name that is not a plain file name, two names that read as one, or files of two formats. Nothing is kept; the user picks the files again.

import_options_invalid.why: A model import's options are not a small JSON object of short lowercase keys and single finite values. Nothing is read or kept.

import_format_elsewhere.why: The file is a format with its own import (the Excel input workbook); the message names where to import it. Nothing is kept.

import_timeout.why: The importer's child process ran past its time budget and was stopped. Nothing is kept; the message suggests a smaller case.

import_unavailable.why: This build does not carry the importers (gridspine is optional at runtime). Nothing is read or kept; the user imports in a build that has them.

import_busy.why: As many model imports as the app reads at once are already running. Nothing is read or kept; the user tries again shortly.

import_sidecar_refused.why: The importer returned a file the project does not keep, or metadata keys the project owns. Nothing is kept: no project row and no folder.
